rounds.text: The valuation of GYFTR is disconnected from fundamental reality, evidenced by a lofty P/E of 57.7 [E1] and a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of Rs 32 per share that results in a severe -417.7% margin of safety [E39, E40]. Profitability metrics are exceptionally weak, featuring a low ROE of 5.2% [E7], a depressed 10-year median ROE of 9% [E20], and an operating margin that collapsed by 77 percentage points to -8% in March 2026 [E24]. Furthermore, earnings quality is heavily compromised since reported profits include Rs 64.6 Cr of other income [E58], free cash flow stands at a negative Rs -22 Cr [E30], and promoters have reduced their stake by 13.54 percentage points down to 50.08% [E35]. The technical setup confirms severe distress as the stock trades below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E44] with a twelve-month price return of -69.3% [E46], landing the rules-based screen at a dismal 29 out of 100 with a sell rating [E60]. Conceded: compounded sales growth reached 2580% over the trailing twelve months [E11] and foreign institutional holding increased by 5.10 percentage points [E36].
